descFull: Sno Station — your Claude Code and Codex working as one squad on your own machine. Shared encrypted memory, agent-to-agent messaging (Reach), squad skills for handoff and cross-vendor review, and a nightly loop that rewrites the agents' own skills with your approval. Open source, no daemon, no cloud required. Assembled in public.
